title: Untitled (CD Field Chaos)
description: Seven compact discs are distributed across a densely layered mixed-media collage incorporating ink drawings, painted fragments, paper cutouts, and a gold star shape. Iridescent discs anchor the composition amid overlapping figural sketches, red geometric patches, and handwritten text on a white ground.
